name: Chunked Marching Cubes Terrain Generation
definition: A chunked implementation of the Marching Cubes algorithm using Unity's Job System and Burst Compiler to generate terrain meshes from volumetric density data. It processes voxels in parallel chunks to allow for dynamic terrain modification.
summary: Chunked Marching Cubes Terrain Generation is a real-time, infinite, and destructible voxel terrain system that processes voxels in parallel chunks to enable dynamic modification and world streaming.
